page_title: CoderPlan - Developer-first Claude Code/Codex and Gemini CLI API gateway

sources.entry: CoderPlan - LLM API Gateway with OpenAI-compatible interface. Pay-per-use access to Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok. One-line config for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI. #freemium

summary.name: CoderPlan
summary.one_liner: A pay-as-you-go API gateway that routes Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, and Gemini CLI traffic to Claude, GPT, and Gemini models through one endpoint, billed per use from prepaid credit.
keywords: pay as you go ai api
use_cases: Running Claude Code or Codex CLI without a monthly subscription
Pointing Cursor or Gemini CLI at a single API endpoint
Tracking per-request token and cache costs for coding agents
Reducing bills for long-context repeated-prompt coding sessions
Sharing API keys across a small development team
summary.what_it_does: CoderPlan provides a single API endpoint that works with OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible clients, so tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, and Gemini CLI can be pointed at it with one base URL and API key. It offers access to Claude, GPT, and Gemini models, and the listing also names DeepSeek and Grok. Billing is pay-per-use from top-up credit that the page says never expires, with no monthly fee or quota windows. Each request is logged with model, input/output tokens, cache reads, cache savings, status, and credit change. The page states model prices are a multiple (ratio) of official list prices and gives example per-token rates in USD per million tokens.
notable: Pay-as-you-go credit that does not expire, with no monthly subscription or usage caps
Per-request logs showing tokens, cache reads, savings, and cost
Dual-protocol endpoint compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic clients
Model prices listed as a ratio of official list prices, with some models shown as far below official rates
caveats: Trial credit is only awarded if the platform offers it; the page says this is not guaranteed
Top-ups are processed by Stripe with international cards; Chinese fapiao invoices are not supported
Cost savings depend on cache hit rates; the page notes actual usage varies by model and task
Page claims prices as low as about 4% of official list, which the page itself qualifies with cost-structure caveats rather than independent verification
